about_the_game:
Explore. Fight. Climb. Fall. Try again.

In Bililitz, each game is a new procedurally generated vertical journey, where the challenge is to survive and climb as high as possible. Collect orbs, discover doors that lead to other worlds, and test your skills in a frenetic cycle of action and exploration.

About the Demo

This is the demo version of Bililitz, created to give you a taste of the full experience:

A complete vertical world to explore.

Starting items and abilities available.

Active global ranking system — prove you're the best.

Limited access to the worlds and special challenges of the full version.

Features

Procedural vertical exploration — every attempt is unique.

Fast-paced and precise combat, with attacks, jumps, and dodges.

Challenging rogue-like — death is just the beginning.

Mysterious items and magical orbs that change your strategy.

Scoring system and global ranking — literally climb the leaderboards!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or equivalent
  • Graphics: Any card with OpenGL 3.0 support
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3 or higher
  • Graphics: Basic dedicated card (Nvidia GT 710 / AMD Radeon R5) or modern integrated
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
